title: Graphene oxide functionalized tannic acid–trimethylolpropane triglycidyl ether nanoparticles: a versatile network nanocatalyst for synthesis of 4-substituted-1,5-benzodiazepine derivatives
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,5979-5989
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA08633G, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Alireza Gharehkhani, Maryam Hajjami, Reza Hazbavi
An efficient protocol for designing graphene oxide functionalized tannic acid and trimethylolpropane triglycidyl ether (GO@tannic acid–TTE) as a nanocatalyst for the synthesis of 4-substituted-1,5-benzodiazepine derivatives has been developed.
